The UK Government has signalled that it is going to ease its net-zero goals, which would be a “real mistake”, says chair of the Adaptation Committee of the UK's Climate Change Committee, Baroness Brown, Julia King. 

Julia King, Laurie Laybourn and Paul Tompkins were speaking to Carole Walker on Times Radio Drive.  Listen live every day, 4-7pm.
